notes.title: The Final Chapters
notes.content:
We have finished the two final chapters and integrated them into our game. The continue button is now enabled and you can seamlessly continue the adventure.
We have taken your suggested improvements and bug reports into account as far as possible. Thank you very much for your feedback and support.
The new version supports the French language.
We have also made some changes to the safe. This should fix the bug that some players encountered.
Have fun playing.

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
First of all, we apologize for not having had an update for a long time. The last two months just flew by. In recent weeks we have invested a great deal of time in making minor adjustments and fixing bugs. In addition, the Trading Cards are now available.
We plan on releasing the complete game in the middle of September.

notes.content: Currently we are working on the optimization of the gameplay and fixing bugs. In addition, some text still needs to be translated. The final version will be released in French as well. notes.title: Short update on the state of development
notes.content:
In the last two months we have been working on the missing two chapters. Many new 3D models were created for the vaults under the house. Now there is a need for a lot of fine tuning.
We are also working on fixing the bugs reported by you and your desired improvements. Thanks again for your help.

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.content:
First, thanks to everyone for playing our game. Thank you for your suggestions and bug reports.

In update 0.5.1 we have fixed many of the reported bugs. The most serious error was certainly the "Inventory Bug". We have made some changes and believe that this bug was eliminated. Unfortunately we cannot check on our computers because this error never occurred to us. Any feedback on this issue is greatly appreciated.

Release Notes:
[list]
[*]Inventory Bug fixed
[*]Dot in the initial logo removed
[*]Missing or incorrect item descriptions updated / corrected
[*]Left statue lacking mesh on the bottom
[*]Invisible walls in the upstairs hallway, right part removed
[*]Menu sound made quieter
[*]Map with coordinates made brighter
[*]Steps sound during jump disabled
[*]Corrections in Russian translation (Credits to the Tolma4Team)
[/list]

Cheers
TripleBrick

notes.title: Vernon s Legacy Starts Spooking Later This Month
notes.content:
“The war, Robert… The war changed everything.”

Vernon’s Legacy [official site] is an atmospheric first-person horror game following the terrifying footprints of Amnesia and Soma and scheduled to hit Early Access on March 31st. Set in 1920 Germany, you explore a seemingly abandoned house, with letters and notes scattered around everywhere, solving puzzles in order to uncover the mysterious changes that the war has brought. I set foot in the house myself with a preview build, and what I’ve seen is promising, although there are a number of small things that risk to ruin the atmosphere. And is that a Fallout reference?!

… [visit site to read more]
